My New Second Chance [EP33] [FREE]

A downloadable game for Windows, macOS, Linux, and Android

You play as the "MC" who has lived and worked his entire life just to stay alive until one day something mysterious happens and gives you the chance to go back in time and fix all your past mistakes. What awaits you on this new journey?

Reconnect with old friends and make new ones as you progress through your journey. 

It's up to you to decide what to do.  

ALL THE GIRLS ARE OVER 18 YEARS OLD.

Hey friends, how are you all doing? 👋😊

Sorry for the delay, but EP33 is finally complete. The reason it took a little longer than usual is that, in addition to my other projects, I’ve been polishing some scripts and improving various systems across the games.
Anyway, the game has now entered Season 2, even though it still continues as EP33. Because of this, in order to play EP33, you must have a save file from the end of EP32. Please keep that in mind.
But then, what’s new in this EP?

A New Season Opening Intro.


Since the game has entered a new season, it’s only natural that it would get a new intro. And, as has become a tradition in my games, I almost always change the intros depending on the EP. So here it is, a brand new intro.

Additionally, if you don't have your old save file, or if your old save won't load, simply click "New Chance", answer a few questions, and you'll be able to continue directly from EP33.


So this should solve the problem that some players, especially those playing on the Android version have been experiencing.


Updated CGI Gallery (Again).


Now it has been updated in its final form, allowing you to choose which EP’s videos you want to view. Of course, not every video is included there, since I only added the ones that I feel are important to have in the gallery.


New improved “About” screen.


This update is now available in this game and all of my other games as well. I was just polishing it before, and now the screen looks much better and more organized. So I really don’t plan on making any major changes to it anytime soon.


New girls have been added to the Harem, along with a completely updated Harem Tracker.


I’ve now completely updated the Harem Tracker screen to make it look a bit nicer while still keeping the overall aesthetic it already had. I hope you all like the new design.


That said, what else is new in this episode?
